title: Remove A-Axis Gearbox (LOTO, side panel access, gripper removal, counter-balance handling)
summary: Safely remove the OptiSweep A-axis gearbox assembly by performing LOTO, removing the station side panel to access the motor, removing the gripper, and controlling counter-balance drift after gripper removal (either allow drift to the lower hard stop or remove the counter-balance weight).
when_to_use: Use when the OptiSweep A-axis gearbox must be removed and you need to follow the manual’s LOTO and disassembly sequence, including managing counter-balance drift risk after gripper removal.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Execute the physical disassembly steps (LOTO, side panel removal, gripper removal, gearbox unmounting/removal) and control counter-balance drift as specified.
safety_notes: Most fasteners in the A-axis gearbox have Loctite® 277™, so removal may be difficult (use appropriate tools and control unexpected movement).

After gripper removal, the system will be out of balance and the counter-balance will want to drift down; it is acceptable to allow drift to the lower hard stop or optionally remove the counter-balance weight to help balance the system.
If unexpected motion occurs during disassembly, stop and re-check LOTO.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the A-axis gearbox area
Tools: torque wrench, 4-mm hex wrench, 3/8-in. wrench/socket, standard screwdriver

access_required: Physical access to the A-axis gearbox area
system_preconditions: System is ready for lockout/tagout per the manual’s referenced "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" procedure.
external_references: Manual cross-reference: "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2 (referenced by the A-axis gearbox removal section).
Manual cross-reference: "Removal" on page 97 for gripper removal.

visual_references.description: Figure 7-6 (A-Axis Gearbox) supporting the A-axis gearbox removal sequence and fastener/tooling context.

steps.title: Perform LOTO on the system
steps.purpose: Ensure the system is locked out/tagged out before removing the side panel and disassembling the A-axis gearbox.
steps.instruction: Perform LOTO on the system using the manual’s referenced "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" procedure.
steps.expected_result: The system is in a locked-out/tagged-out state prior to side panel removal.
steps.healthy_condition: No unexpected motion occurs when you begin disassembly actions.
steps.failure_condition: Any unexpected motion occurs during disassembly.

actions.label: Execute Operator Station Lockout/Tagout
actions.exact_action: LOTO the system (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: If any unexpected motion occurs during disassembly, stop and re-check LOTO.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.6.1 REMOVAL step 1: "LOTO the system (see \"Operator Station Lockout/Tagout\" on page 2)."

steps.title: Remove the station side panel to access the motor
steps.purpose: Expose the motor area by removing the nine self-tapping fasteners securing the station side panel.
steps.instruction: Using a 3/8-in. wrench or socket, remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.
steps.expected_result: The station side panel is removed and the motor access area is exposed.
steps.healthy_condition: Side panel removal is complete without unexpected movement; motor access is visible.
steps.failure_condition: Unexpected motion occurs during side panel removal, or the side panel cannot be removed due to uncontrolled fastener resistance.

actions.label: Remove side panel fasteners
actions.exact_action: Use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

stop_or_escalate_if: If any unexpected motion occurs during disassembly, stop and re-check LOTO.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.6.1 REMOVAL step 2: "Use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor."
A-axis gearbox note: "Most fasteners in the A-axis gearbox have Loctite® 277™, so removal may be difficult."

steps.title: Remove the gripper
steps.purpose: Remove the gripper as required by the A-axis gearbox removal sequence; this triggers the counter-balance drift condition that must be managed next.
steps.instruction: Remove the gripper (manual cross-reference: "Removal" on page 97).
steps.healthy_condition: After gripper removal, you observe the system out-of-balance condition and can control the counter-balance drift as described in the next step.
steps.failure_condition: Counter-balance drift cannot be controlled to the lower hard stop (or by the optional counter-balance weight removal approach).
stop_or_escalate_if: If the counter-balance drift cannot be controlled to the lower hard stop (or by removing the counter-balance weight as allowed), stop and escalate to qualified support before proceeding.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.6.1 REMOVAL step 3: "Remove the gripper (see \"Removal\" on page 97)."

steps.title: Control counter-balance drift after gripper removal
steps.purpose: Manage the out-of-balance condition so the counter-balance drift is controlled to the lower hard stop or balanced by removing the counter-balance weight.
steps.instruction: After gripper removal, allow the counter-balance to drift down to the lower hard stop OR remove the counter-balance weight to help balance the system.
steps.expected_result: Counter-balance drift is controlled: either it reaches the lower hard stop or the counter-balance weight is removed to balance the system.
steps.healthy_condition: The counter-balance drift proceeds in a controlled manner to the lower hard stop, or the counter-balance weight is removed as an alternative balancing method.
steps.failure_condition: Counter-balance drift cannot be controlled to the lower hard stop (or by removing the counter-balance weight as allowed).

actions.label: Allow drift to lower hard stop
actions.exact_action: It is acceptable to allow it to drift to the lower hard stop, or optionally, the counter-balance weight can be removed to help balance the system.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the counter-balance drift cannot be controlled to the lower hard stop (or by removing the counter-balance weight as allowed), stop and escalate to qualified support before proceeding.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.6.1 REMOVAL step 4: "With the gripper removed, the system will be out of balance: the counter-balance will want to drift down. It is acceptable to allow it to drift to the lower hard stop, or optionally, the counter-balance weight can be removed to help balance the system."
Figure 7-4 note: "Once the weights are removed, the carriage may begin to move. The movement is acceptable as the gripper will drift to the lower hard stop."

steps.title: Remove the gearbox without removing the motor (motor may be needed for fastener access)
steps.purpose: Proceed with gearbox removal while noting that motor removal may be required to access fasteners.
steps.instruction: Remove the gearbox without removing the motor; if fastener access requires it, remove the motor (manual cross-reference: "Motor Removal" on page 106).
steps.expected_result: You are positioned to remove the gearbox mounting fasteners; motor removal is only performed if required for fastener access.
steps.healthy_condition: Gearbox mounting fasteners are accessible for removal without unnecessary motor removal.
steps.failure_condition: Fasteners cannot be accessed safely without removing the motor, or removal attempts cause uncontrolled movement.

actions.label: Assess fastener access
actions.exact_action: Remove the gearbox without removing the motor. However, the motor will likely need to be removed for fastener access. See "Motor Removal" on page 106.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot access fasteners safely without causing uncontrolled movement, stop and escalate to qualified support before proceeding.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.6.1 REMOVAL step 5: "Remove the gearbox without removing the motor. However, the motor will likely need to be removed for fastener access. See \"Motor Removal\" on page 106."

steps.title: Remove the gearbox mounting screws
steps.purpose: Detach the gearbox from the carriage by removing the eight (8) M5x18 socket-head screws.
steps.instruction: Remove the eight (8) M5x18 socket-head screws mounting the gearbox to the carriage.
steps.expected_result: All eight (8) M5x18 socket-head screws are removed and the gearbox is no longer secured to the carriage.
steps.healthy_condition: No remaining fasteners secure the gearbox; gearbox can be lifted/removed without binding.
steps.failure_condition: Any screw remains engaged, or the gearbox binds due to misalignment or remaining fasteners.

actions.label: Remove gearbox screws
actions.exact_action: Remove the eight (8) M5x18 socket-head screws mounting the gearbox to the carriage.

stop_or_escalate_if: If fasteners resist removal due to Loctite® 277 and you cannot remove them without risking uncontrolled movement, stop and escalate to qualified support before proceeding.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.6.1 REMOVAL step 6: "Remove the eight (8) M5x18 socket-head screws mounting the gearbox to the carriage."

steps.title: Remove the gearbox
steps.purpose: Complete the gearbox removal by lifting the gearbox assembly away from the carriage.
steps.expected_result: The gearbox is removed from the carriage.
steps.healthy_condition: Gearbox removal completes without unexpected motion of the counter-balance system.
steps.failure_condition: Unexpected motion occurs during gearbox removal, or the gearbox cannot be removed due to remaining attachment points.
stop_or_escalate_if: If any unexpected motion occurs during disassembly, stop and re-check LOTO.
If the gearbox cannot be removed cleanly, stop and escalate to qualified support before proceeding.

success_criteria: Station side panel is removed to access the motor.
Counter-balance drift is controlled: either drift to the lower hard stop or counter-balance weight removed to help balance the system.
Gearbox is unmounted after removing eight (8) M5x18 socket-head screws and is removed.
healthy_conditions: No unexpected motion occurs during disassembly.
After gripper removal, counter-balance drift is controlled as specified (lower hard stop or counter-balance weight removal).
All eight (8) M5x18 socket-head screws are removed and gearbox removal is unimpeded.
failure_conditions: Unexpected motion occurs during disassembly (indicates LOTO issue).
Counter-balance drift cannot be controlled to the lower hard stop (or by removing the counter-balance weight as allowed).
Gearbox cannot be removed due to remaining attachment points or uncontrolled binding.
escalation_guidance: If counter-balance drift cannot be controlled to the lower hard stop (or by removing the counter-balance weight as allowed), stop and escalate to qualified support before proceeding.
If unexpected motion occurs during disassembly, stop and re-check LOTO.
